title: The most chaotic Olympic race ever (1904) #olympics #shorts
description: The 1904 St. Louis Olympic marathon: Fred Lorz rode in a car and crossed first, winner Thomas Hicks was given strychnine, egg whites and brandy, and Félix Carvajal napped after eating bad apples and still finished fourth. Sources: Olympics.com, Smithsonian, Wikipedia.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: The nineteen oh four Olympic marathon might be the most chaotic race in history.
scenes.title: THE WORST OLYMPIC RACE EVER

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: It ran on dusty roads in St. Louis. Thirty two runners started. Only fourteen finished.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Fred Lorz dropped out around mile nine, then hitched a ride in a car for about ten miles.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: He jogged into the stadium first and nearly got the gold medal, until people found out.

scenes.speaker: b
scenes.say: The real winner, Thomas Hicks, got strychnine, a poison, mixed with egg whites and brandy from his own trainers.

scenes.speaker: d
scenes.say: And Cuban runner Félix Carvajal ate some bad apples, took a nap, and still finished fourth.

scenes.speaker: d
scenes.say: A car, a nap, and poison. Which runner is your favorite?
